analyses.content: 录音明确说明20英镑和10英镑的票已经售罄，目前只剩下少量15英镑的票。
你可能会听到20或10就直接填入，但要注意录音中紧接着说这两种票已经卖光（sold out）。

Do you know if there are still tickets available? Let me just have a look. Yes, there are. The 20 pound tickets have sold out. In fact, they sold out even before the 10 pound tickets, but there are still a few at 15 pounds. They're selling fast, though, so you'll need to book very soon.
录音中女声询问是否会有电影节（film festival），男声给出了肯定的确认。
这个答案是由提问者直接说出并由对方确认的，你可能会因为习惯性只听回答者提供的信息而漏掉这里的互动确认。
Are you also interested in any of the arts events? There's usually a film festival, isn't there? Yes. It runs from 10 in the morning until midnight both days.
录音中男声明确说明，为了容纳更多观众，今年的举办场地改在了户外的公园（park）。
你可能会被前面女声提到的市政厅（town hall）干扰，但那只是往年的举办地，且不是题干要求的户外场地（outside）。
Where's the festival taking place? It's usually at the town hall, isn't it? Yes, but this year it's outside in the park so that there's more room for spectators.
录音中男声直接报出了完整的电话号码，只需要如实记录即可。
录音中使用了“double”来表示连续相同的两个数字（double 4、double 5），你可能会在听到连读时反应慢半拍导致漏记。
Have you got her number? Yes. It's oh one 7 double 4 9 double 5 3 two one. That's her home phone number, so it's best to ring evenings or weekends.
录音明确提到，周六晚上演奏的音乐来自非洲（Africa）的各个地区（various regions对应题干different parts）。
你可能会听到伦敦（London）就直接填上，但录音中伦敦是乐团的来源地，并非音乐的来源地。

Are there any music events during the weekend? Oh, yes, several. A youth orchestra from London is performing at Hengrave Theater on Saturday evening. All the music they're playing is from various regions of Africa. It's part of the theater's Weekend of World Music. There'll be people playing informally all day, as well as the particular events.
录音直接指出，周日晚上当地的一个俱乐部会表演来自印度（India）的传统歌曲。
这个题目比较直接，只要跟上周日晚上（Sunday evening）的时间节奏就能抓到答案，注意不要拼错国家名称。
Any other music events? Sunday evening, a local club is performing traditional songs from India. I've heard them. They're very good.
录音中男声解释说，市场里会有摊位烹饪并售卖来自世界各地的食物（food）。
你可能会因为女声提问时说到的衣服（clothes）而受到干扰，但男声紧接着就否定了卖衣服的说法，并给出了正确信息。

But you might also be interested in the market. The market? Don't they just sell clothes? No, it's a special one for that weekend. There'll be stalls with people cooking and selling food from all around the world. It's open from 9 till 4 both days in Market Square.
录音中男声明确说明，关于航运发展的展览在图书馆（library）举办。
你可能会听到提问中的城市博物馆（City Museum）就填上去，但录音紧接着解释博物馆目前正在翻修处于关闭状态。

And are there any exhibitions? There's a special exhibition showing how shipping has evolved over the centuries and contributed to international trade. That might be good. Is it at the City Museum? At the library. The museum is closed for renovation at the moment.
录音中提到俄罗斯作家将探讨诗歌以及翻译（translating）诗歌所面临的困难（difficulties对应题干problems）。
你可能会把听到的诗歌（poetry）填进去，但题干问的是关于什么的“问题”，对应录音里说的翻译困难，另外注意此处必须填写动名词形式。

And on the Sunday of the International Weekend, there are a number of events focusing on literature. That sounds different. A well-known writer from Russia is going to discuss poetry and the difficulties of translating it.
录音中男声非常清楚地逐个拼写了网址邮箱后缀的字母，直接记录拼写即可。
这种拼写题你可能会在区分读音相似的辅音字母（比如M和N、D和T）时出错，需要集中注意力跟紧拼写节奏。

Is there a website with all this information? Yes. You can find full details on the International Weekend website. The address is hengrave.international@beaumond.com. Hengrave.international@... Could you spell the next bit, please? Of course. It's B-E-A-U-M-O-N-D dot com.
